## The ticket is not the rule
## A line on a graph proves nothing
## The question no source can answer

terms.meaning: A bounded observation supporting a claim without deciding organizational authority.
A source-bound interpretation awaiting the responsible owner's decision.
The explicit adoption or rejection of a bounded rule by its declared meaning owner.
A named unresolved question whose blocked uses remain explicit.
A navigable game location whose environmental objects expose only a bounded portion of the incident evidence and whose exits preserve prerequisite constraints.
A partial execution locator emitted by one in-world subsystem machine after the player operates it. No witness identifies the replay alone.
A subject, time window, and machine checksum assembled from independent machine witnesses and used to select one deterministic execution replay.
A seeded event stream whose signal order survives a browser reload so two captures can support, but not overstate, replay determinism.
A navigable three-dimensional projection of an exploration place in which proximity, sightline, movement, and physical interaction reveal bounded evidence without changing its authority posture.
